meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 多了一套网络搜索和网页提取能力:可搜索网络(含语义查找、研究、时事,可限定科研论文和学术域名),也可批量提取网页、文章、学术 PDF 的内容。
howto.when: 当用户要求搜索网络、查询资料,或要求抓取/提取某个链接(网页、文章、PDF等)的内容时触发;涉及学术或科研来源筛选时也会使用。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude gains Exa web search and URL extraction: semantic lookups, research, current info (optionally research-paper category and academic domains), plus batch fetching of pages, articles, academic PDFs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to search the web, look something up, or extract content from a URL (webpage, article, PDF, etc.). Also used when scholarly/research filtering is desired.

say_en.text: Search for recent research papers on quantum computing since 2024.
say_en.note: Uses Exa search biased toward academic sources.

say_en.text: Extract the full content of this page: https://example.com

say_en.text: Find review articles on applying machine learning to drug discovery this year.
say_en.note: Searches and filters for scholarly reviews.
